notes: I ran the five config lines of the Worked example as written, with the changed binary built into .vloop/tmp/vs/bin. `vloop init` inside .vloop/tmp reports 'already initialized' because it finds the parent repo's .vloop, so I ran the example in a mktemp directory outside the repo. That directory is not under .vloop/tmp and is not cleaned up. All five lines gave the stated output and exit code: 0, 0, 2 with config.toml unchanged, 1, 0. I also checked that `vloop doctor` prints the VLOOP_AGENT_WORK source error, that `config list` shows the five agent.* keys, and that `schema list` includes session/v3 and metrics/v3. I did not run the base-versus-changed stub comparison, the planted-flag diff, `metrics --json` on a harness run, or the v1/v2 base-written run-directory example. The comparison needs a base binary built from the base SHA. The repo's tests have no base-binary comparison. Only the gate scripts under .vloop/state/gates/ (T1 and T2 mention git archive) do, and I did not run those. I ran only cmd/vloop TestRunClaudeInvocations and TestRunRecords*. They pass and pin argv, cwd, env pass-through and drops, and session/v3 agent and cost_source, including cost_source none without total_cost_usd. The records of the run's own sessions are session/v1, written by the installed vloop, so they cannot show v3. The contract sentences on records and metrics were checked by reading the diff (internal/runs, internal/metrics, doctor.go, the docs), not by running a harness run.
